title: [Feature Request] Reduce Authentication Frequency for Claude Code CLI
body:
**Bug Description**
You are asking me to log in way too much time. I have to log in like 20 times per day. Make this once every 3 days or once a day, please.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: ghostty
- Version: 2.0.0
